nodes.label: Note Fields style
nodes.rationale: Each chapter is one softly lit rupee-note-slot field; passbooks/receipts/slips are paper objects with soft depth and tilt, marked in blue ballpoint and stamp red; 3-second test.

nodes.label: Motion + cut rules (snap entrances, real-editor transitions)
nodes.rationale: Entrances: opacity full on the cut frame, power3.out motion, overshoot only for mascot/stamp; hard cuts by default, whip/zoom/wipe/page budget 1/2/3, never text title cards; new visual every 2-3 s.
nodes.norm_label: motion + cut rules (snap entrances, real-editor transitions)

nodes.label: Chillar ₹1 coin mascot (8 expressions)
nodes.rationale: Mascot reactions replace copyrighted memes; deadpan, never fully smiles.

nodes.label: No on-screen structure labels rule
nodes.rationale: Chapter names / setup / payoff on screen are AI-look tells; validator blocks them.

nodes.label: Show, don't caption
nodes.rationale: Caption band already carries the words; frame must add an object/number/reaction.
